/**
 * [page-boot] A page's first reads, run while doGet renders the page, so the
 * data arrives INSIDE the HTML instead of costing google.script.run round
 * trips. Each round trip costs ~6 s of platform time before the first line of
 * this project runs (measured); on et_customers the table appeared after
 * 9.8 s embedded against 25.6 s the old way, on et_products 14.4 s against 25.0 s.
 *
 * Which reads a page gets is DATA, not code: PAGE_BOOT_READS (Page_Boot_Reads.js,
 * generated by tools/pageboot/gen_reads.js from tools/pageboot/inventory.json).
 * doGet calls pageBootInject_, which prepends to <head>:
 *   <script>window.__PAGE_BOOT__ = { page, company, mode, reads: [...] }</script>
 *   + the client runtime (Page_Boot.html)
 * and Client_Helpers' API.call answers a matching read from it once.
 *
 *   - READ ONLY. A read that is not a get_ action is refused before dispatch.
 *   - Same authorization as an apiRouter read: executeCompanyAction_ with the
 *     user doGet has already authenticated. No user, no injection.
 *   - FAILS OPEN, per read. A failed or oversized read embeds reply: null and
 *     the page fetches it exactly as before.
 *   - OFF SWITCH: Script Property PAGE_BOOT_OFF = 1 stops every injection on
 *     the next page load, no deploy needed. ?embed=0 on a URL turns it off for
 *     that load only (the speed panel's comparison uses this).
 */
var PAGE_BOOT_MAX_BYTES_DEFAULT_ = 300000;

/* Tokens in PAGE_BOOT_READS data, filled in per request:
 *   $param:<name>   the URL parameter, '' when absent
 *   $sessionToken   this request's session token
 *   $scriptUrl      this deployment's URL
 *   $date:today, $date:monthStart, $date:monthEnd   'yyyy-MM-dd', script time zone
 *   $date:year      the current year, as a number
 * Any other value passes through unchanged. */
function pageBootResolve_(v, ctx) {
  if (typeof v === 'string' && v.charAt(0) === '$') {
    if (v.indexOf('$param:') === 0) {
      var pv = ctx.params ? ctx.params[v.slice(7)] : undefined;
      return (pv === undefined || pv === null) ? '' : String(pv);
    }
    if (v === '$sessionToken') return String(ctx.sessionToken || '');
    if (v === '$scriptUrl') return String(ctx.scriptUrl || '');
    if (v.indexOf('$date:') === 0) {
      var tz = ctx.tz || 'Africa/Cairo';
      var now = ctx.now || new Date();
      var y = Number(Utilities.formatDate(now, tz, 'yyyy'));
      var mo = Number(Utilities.formatDate(now, tz, 'MM'));
      var pad = function (n) { return ('0' + n).slice(-2); };
      if (v === '$date:year') return y;
      if (v === '$date:today') return Utilities.formatDate(now, tz, 'yyyy-MM-dd');
      if (v === '$date:monthStart') return y + '-' + pad(mo) + '-01';
      if (v === '$date:monthEnd') return y + '-' + pad(mo) + '-' + pad(new Date(y, mo, 0).getDate());
    }
    return v;
  }
  if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.map(function (x) { return pageBootResolve_(x, ctx); });
  if (v && typeof v === 'object') {
    var o = {};
    Object.keys(v).forEach(function (k) { o[k] = pageBootResolve_(v[k], ctx); });
    return o;
  }
  return v;
}

/* Runs the reads IN ORDER (get_page_versions first, so the stamps are never
   newer than the data they describe) and returns
   { server_ms, reads: [{ action, data, ok, reply, error?, ms }] } — data is the
   RESOLVED data, which is what the client matches its calls against. */
function pageBootRun_(user, companyUid, reads, ctx) {
  var t0 = Date.now();
  var out = { server_ms: 0, reads: [] };
  var max = PAGE_BOOT_MAX_BYTES_DEFAULT_;
  try { max = Number(readScriptProperty_('PAGE_BOOT_MAX_BYTES', '')) || PAGE_BOOT_MAX_BYTES_DEFAULT_; } catch (eMax) {}
  (reads || []).forEach(function (r) {
    var t1 = Date.now();
    var action = String((r && r.action) || '');
    var data = pageBootResolve_((r && r.data && typeof r.data === 'object') ? r.data : {}, ctx || {});
    var entry = { action: action, data: data, ok: false, reply: null, ms: 0 };
    try {
      if (!user) throw new Error('no authenticated user');
      if (!isReadAction_(action)) throw new Error('page boot is read-only: ' + action);
      var reply = jsonSafe_(executeCompanyAction_({ target_system: String(companyUid || ''), module_action: action, data: data }, '', user));
      var size = JSON.stringify(reply).length;
      if (reply && reply.status === 'error') throw new Error(String(reply.message || reply.code || 'error'));
      if (size > max) throw new Error('too large to embed (' + size + ' bytes > ' + max + ')');
      entry.reply = reply;
      entry.ok = true;
      entry.bytes = size;
    } catch (e) {
      entry.reply = null;
      entry.error = String((e && e.message) || e);
    }
    entry.ms = Date.now() - t1;
    out.reads.push(entry);
  });
  out.server_ms = Date.now() - t0;
  return out;
}

/* Kept for templates that call it directly: the same run, as a JS expression. */
function pageBootJson_(user, companyUid, readsJson, ctx) {
  var reads = [];
  try { reads = typeof readsJson === 'string' ? JSON.parse(readsJson || '[]') : (readsJson || []); } catch (e) { reads = []; }
  return JSON.stringify(pageBootRun_(user, companyUid, reads, ctx || {})).replace(/</g, '\\u003c');
}

/* The <head> prefix for one page load, or '' — no user, no entry in
   PAGE_BOOT_READS, or the off switch. Never throws. */
function pageBootInject_(action, authUser, params, scriptUrl) {
  try {
    if (!authUser || typeof PAGE_BOOT_READS === 'undefined') return '';
    var spec = PAGE_BOOT_READS[String(action || '')];
    if (!spec || !spec.company || !spec.reads || !spec.reads.length) return '';
    var offSwitch = '';
    try { offSwitch = String(readScriptProperty_('PAGE_BOOT_OFF', '') || ''); } catch (eOff) { offSwitch = ''; }
    if (offSwitch === '1' || offSwitch.toLowerCase() === 'true') return '';
    params = params || {};
    var ctx = { params: params, sessionToken: String(params.sessionToken || ''), scriptUrl: String(scriptUrl || ''),
      tz: (function () { try { return Session.getScriptTimeZone(); } catch (eTz) { return 'Africa/Cairo'; } })(), now: new Date() };
    var cfg;
    if (String(params.embed || '') === '0') {
      /* Off for this load: declare the reads (resolved) so the panel can still
         time them, but embed nothing. */
      cfg = { mode: 'off', server_ms: 0, reads: spec.reads.map(function (r) {
        return { action: String(r.action || ''), data: pageBootResolve_(r.data || {}, ctx), ok: false, reply: null, ms: 0 };
      }) };
    } else {
      cfg = pageBootRun_(authUser, spec.company, spec.reads, ctx);
      cfg.mode = 'embed';
    }
    cfg.page = String(action);
    cfg.company = String(spec.company);
    cfg.waitFor = String(spec.waitFor || '');
    cfg.admin = !!authUser.isSuperAdmin;
    /* The query string without the session, so the panel can reopen THIS page
       (print pages carry their record id here). */
    cfg.query = Object.keys(params).filter(function (k) { return k !== 'sessionToken' && k !== 'embed'; })
      .map(function (k) { return encodeURIComponent(k) + '=' + encodeURIComponent(String(params[k])); }).join('&');
    var runtime = '';
    try { runtime = HtmlService.createHtmlOutputFromFile('Page_Boot').getContent(); } catch (eRt) { runtime = ''; }
    if (!runtime) return '';
    return '<script>window.__PAGE_BOOT__=' + JSON.stringify(cfg).replace(/</g, '\\u003c') + ';</' + 'script>' + runtime;
  } catch (e) {
    try { console.warn('pageBootInject_ ' + action + ': ' + ((e && e.message) || e)); } catch (e2) {}
    return '';
  }
}
